description: This Java test class contains unit tests for the ImmutablePolicyEntry class within the org.eclipse.ditto.model.policies package. It verifies immutability, JSON serialization/deserialization, equality, and exception handling for ImmutablePolicyEntry instances.

classes.name: ImmutablePolicyEntryTest
classes.description: Unit test class for the ImmutablePolicyEntry class, testing immutability, JSON conversion, equality, and exception cases.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Tests that ImmutablePolicyEntry and related classes are immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of hashCode and equals implementations using EqualsVerifier.

methods.name: testToAndFromJson
methods.description: Tests JSON serialization and deserialization of ImmutablePolicyEntry.

methods.name: testFromJsonWithNullLabel
methods.description: Ensures a NullPointerException is thrown when null label is provided to fromJson.

methods.name: testFromJsonEmptyWithLabel
methods.description: Ensures a DittoJsonException is thrown when JSON is empty during fromJson.

methods.name: testFromJsonOnlySchemaVersion
methods.description: Checks exception when JSON contains only schema version and no other data.

methods.name: testFromJsonWithTwoEntriesGivesOnlyFirst
methods.description: Verifies that fromJson processes only the first entry when multiple entries are provided.
